Synthetic aircraft operating lease — utilization and excess charge terms

12.4 Utilization allowance. The Lessee shall not exceed 300 flight hours or 500 flight cycles during each lease year.
12.5 Excess flight-hour charges. Any excess flight hours shall be charged at USD 1,000 per flight hour.
12.6 Excess flight-cycle charges. Any excess flight cycles shall be charged at EUR 1,000 per flight cycle.
12.7 Annual cap. Aggregate excess flight-hour charges are capped at USD 100,000 per lease year.
12.8 Measurement date. The lease year ends on 2026-12-31.
